title: S7: wire Python into callers, impact, diff, code-map and --stream (ADR 0008)
description: ADR 0008 / DEC-303 S7. Registers the native Python indexer behind the language seam (S1) so callers, impact, diff, code-map and --stream answer for Python, with --ref through the snapshot. Shared parts only until opum-doc rules the contract A/B (SiteKind decorator, INDEX_FORMAT, additive callBins fields). Rules per case are committed before the code (rules commit SHA recorded here). Specialists are blind to ground-truth files and the scorer; the gate run is S8.

acceptanceCriteria.text: a rules commit exists on the branch before any code commit and its SHA is recorded on this task
a Python-only repository answers callers, impact and code-map with in-repo resolved edges and the coverage and unresolved counts (proof: tests over a fixture repository)
TypeScript-only output is byte-identical to dev (proof: the existing parity tests and a test that fails if it changes)
--ref answers for Python through the snapshot and shares no cache key with the working tree (proof: test)
the cache key carries language, analyzer and grammar version (proof: test that a change to each misses)
a non-empty exit7 list from the analyzer raises exit 7 naming the trigger (proof: test)
bun run check and lore check are green

implementationNotes: S7 rules part 1 (the parts both contract arms share, 12 rules) committed as an empty rules commit e21fcb9ab20a1067fcc9ddae07d9801d0c964a6a on feat/GCLI-82-python-wiring BEFORE any code. Part 2 (SiteKind decorator, INDEX_FORMAT, additive callBins fields) waits for opum-doc's ruling on the A/B put by the leader; it is recorded as a second rules commit before the code that handles it. Specialists are blind to test/python-gate ground-truth files and gate_score.py; check_call_sites.ts must not be run.

RULES PART 2 (DEC-303 (a14), arm A, rules 13-18) committed as empty rules commit bc62148 BEFORE the code that handles it; part 1 is e21fcb9. IMPLEMENTATION: 831d628 (code, tests, ADR 0002 amendment, README) and a05af81 (lore sync of docs/log.md, 0 entries dropped). Worker re-ran bun run check at a05af81 on local bun 1.3.14 (the CI pin is .bun-version, 1.4.2): typecheck, lint, format clean, 666 pass 0 fail. Specialist (Sonnet) reported lore check --strict with the pinned @opum-ai/lore@0.14.1: 0 errors, 0 warnings. Specialist was blind to test/python-gate and ran none of it. OPEN POINTS to put to the reviewer and the leader: (1) rule 4's 'lowers exact and is named in the coverage' has no field in (a14), so exact and parse errors are internal only, nothing is published; a coverage entry needs a ruling. (2) code-map: the Python index is built before produceCodeMap starts its 7 s budget, so a Python build is not budget-covered, and every code-map run now does one extra rev-parse and ls-tree; output unchanged. (3) notIndexed now means present but not indexed in this run (was: no registered indexer); mixed-tree bytes identical. (4) callers gains the three fields after totals (callers never carried unresolvedByKind; adding it would change bytes and is not ruled). (5) S5 site flags are untyped extra properties (SiteEntry & SiteFlags). (6) analyzer version constant is '1', an unruled implementation choice. (7) tests encoding superseded behaviour were updated (language, edges, python-calls result keys); the TS byte golden and parity tests are untouched and green.

REVIEW ROUND (Opus claude-opus-5-5, VERDICT changes at be69051, B1 B2 blocking). opum-doc DEC-303 (a15) (ODOC-640): Q1 adds ONE optional Python-only field parseErrorFiles {path, droppedCalls}[] ordered by path, present only when non-empty, absent for TypeScript and a clean Python run, exact stays internal; Q2 the code-map clock starts before the Python prebuild and a failing Python index is tier 3 missing (exit 0, tiers 1,2,4), the exit7-raises rule does not apply to code-map. RULES PART 3 (rules 19-22) committed as empty commit 4c55c40 BEFORE the code. FIX COMMITS: 63badba (B2 + parseErrorFiles), 223090f (N3 --end-of-options), f7e6e7b (N6 decorator verb), 12ee898 (B1: bare-specifier witness for @vscode/tree-sitter-wasm and a Python callers run from the installed tarball under node, which ran cleanly), d473076 (README and ADR 0002 a15 amendment), 766d088 (lore sync, 0 entries dropped). N4 was already covered by test/python-parse.test.ts (grammarVersion equals the package.json pin and the installed version). SKIPPED, for S8 or later: N2 (Python code-map index never cached), N5 (latent TDZ import cycle snapshot.ts/language.ts/python/indexer.ts), N7 (test gaps: rule 2 bytes-vs-string cannot be told apart, --ref non-UTF-8 case, readRefInputs dropping blobs), N8 (eager tree-sitter import). Worker re-ran at 766d088: tsc clean, bun run check 676 pass 0 fail (local bun 1.3.14), node scripts/check-package.mjs passed incl. bare specifiers and the Python run. OWED: the reviewer had no shell so the empty-commit rules e21fcb9, bc62148 were not read; a literal rule-by-rule pass of rules 1-22 is still owed to whoever re-checks (rules text: git show on those commits, or the leader's s7-rules.txt).
